records.name: l10n_ec.sri.payment.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form string="Payment Method" create="0" edit="0">
                <sheet>
                    <group>
                          <field name="code"/>
                          <field name="name"/>
                          <field name="active"/>
                    </group>
                </sheet>
            </form>
        </field>

records.name: l10n_ec.sri.payment.list
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <list string="Payment Method" create="0">
                <field name="sequence" widget="handle"/>
                <field name="code" readonly="1"/>
                <field name="name" readonly="1"/>
                <field name="active" widget="boolean_toggle" readonly="1"/>
            </list>
        </field>
